misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast record linking each specification, issuance time, and evidence cutoff to its realized outcome could make comparison possible. The supplied evidence does not establish that this would have changed any decision or prevented an observed miss.
misses.decision_relevance: The registry documents missing forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs. Without those, the supplied target-time settlement prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or whether a forecast miss occurred.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: settlement records supply target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but the corresponding forecast specifications, issue times, and evidence cutoffs are absent. No demonstrated decision or forecast failure can be matched to these outcomes.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked realized outcomes are absent, preventing ex-ante alignment and miss assessment.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records, including EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36; records provide target-time prices, not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
